management_steps.details: IM injection. Dissolve benzathine benzylpenicillin 1.2 MU in 3.2 mL lidocaine 1% without adrenaline (epinephrine) or 3 mL water for injection.
Acute treatment / Prophylaxis: Children < 30 kg: 600,000 IU. Children >= 30 kg and adults: 1.2 MU. Prophylaxis frequency: every 21 to 28 days (i.e. 3 to 4 weeks).
Avoid IM injections if patients are on warfarin.

warnings: Avoid IM injections if patients are on warfarin.
